answer: Split-tally stops bulk fakes. Each tally splits into two 45-credit halves: one is a signed work signal held as bond, the other rides a raven by one route, 8 credits a ride. At the horizon checkpoint halves must match or the bond burns. Couriers cap at four halves an epoch, so a shared ring fails. Each fake costs 98: 1,000 fakes burn 98,000 against a 40,000 pool, a net loss of 58,000. Honest agents pay 98 once and reclaim their bond in full.
